question: What baselines do they compare with?

answer.free_form_answer: They compare with the following models: by Pedersen (2017), by Pramanick and Das (2017), by Mikhalkova and Karyakin (2017),  by Vadehra (2017), Indurthi and Oota (2017), by Vechtomova (2017), by (Cai et al., 2018), and CRF.

title: Joint Detection and Location of English Puns
answer_short: CRF, rule-based systems, and prior works that did not employ joint learning
answer_rationale: The document explicitly mentions in the Results section (Text 33) that the authors implemented a baseline model based on CRF and compared their model against prior works that did not use joint learning. Additionally, Text 39 in Related Work lists several prior systems (e.g., BIBREF22, BIBREF24, BIBREF28, BIBREF10, BIBREF23, BIBREF25, UWAV) that address pun detection and location separately, which are implicitly compared as baselines.
